name: BeatRepeat
description: Clock-synced Beat Repeat for NTS-3. Continuously captures AUDIO IN (get_raw_input on firmware 1.4+) and stutters slices on the grid. X = loop length (1/32–2 beats), Y = fire probability, touch = force freeze. SLICE picks which fragment of the last beat to chew on.

params.name: LEN
params.detail: Loop length, tempo-synced from 1/32 to 2 beats

params.name: PROB
params.detail: Chance a new slice starts on the next 16th

params.name: SLICE
params.detail: Which fragment of the captured beat to loop

params.name: FEED
params.detail: How much the repeated slice recirculates
